issues_found.description: compute-integrity-mechanical.js's check_4_data_prose function silently reports acknowledged_failures=0 instead of the real 19. It reads data/uncounted-failures.json via Array.isArray(fails) ? fails : (fails.failures || []), but the file's actual schema key is entries (19 items), not failures, so the fallback resolves to []. This is a bug confined to the integrity precompute artifact's informational field -- the live site and build.js both compute and render 19 correctly via the real entries field, verified by rebuilding and grepping for the resolved {{ACKNOWLEDGED_FAILURES}} placeholder in docs/index.html.
issues_found.suggested_fix: Change (fails.failures || []) to (fails.entries || fails.failures || []) (or just fails.entries || []) so the fallback matches data/uncounted-failures.json's real schema. One-line fix; no downstream consumers currently rely on the wrong 0 value since the field is informational-only in the section 0 consumer protocol.
